name: Supine Hip Cross-Over Stretch
steps: Lie flat on your back with legs extended straight.
Bend your right knee and place your right foot on the outside of your left thigh or knee.
Use your left hand to gently guide your right knee across your body toward the floor on your left side.
Extend your right arm straight out to the right, keeping your right shoulder blade in contact with the mat.
Hold the gentle stretch in your outer hip and glute for 20 to 30 seconds while breathing deeply, then switch sides.
coaching_cues: Do not force your knee all the way to the floor; listen to your body and stop at a gentle stretch.
Keep your right shoulder grounded on the floor.
Relax your neck and jaw as you breathe.

sources.attribution: NHS Hip Mobility and Sciatica Guidelines
